method: paired percentile bootstrap; micro-F1 recomputed from pooled TP/FP/FN in every replicate
failure_policy: All 50 attempts included; failed zero-shot output has no extracted values. Successful-pair analysis is secondary.
limitations: Conditional on observed documents and fixed saved model outputs; no estimate of repeated-generation variation.
H1 uses synthetic documents from six familiar templates; not evidence of new-template generalization.
H2 OCR-only run is later than the image run; provider weights behind a model identifier may change.
Separate marginal 95% intervals, not simultaneous family-wise intervals for two hypotheses.
Confirmatory independence requires no prompt tuning on the evaluated test set.
